$comment: The warm job is the product: we read the Aviasales cache and cannot fill it, so this list decides what Trip Range can price. Each hourly run fetches pairsPerRun origin × month pairs (prices_for_dates + get_latest_prices) and routesPerRun routes (get_latest_prices, period year). Rotation is by hours since epoch, so every item is covered within ceil(items / perRun) hours. Routes deliberately include ones that return nothing today: a successful empty response is recorded as outcome 'empty' (db/migrations/0003).

routes.$comment: Home market origins × destinations: the catalogue, airport-bearing destinations, and the main diaspora and leisure airports from Kosovo, Albania and North Macedonia.
